messages:
omar (new hire): hey all, quick question on Notion onboarding stuff. i filled out the HR form but i still can9t find the "first-month checklist" template. search is noisy  is there a recommended path to the templates and any special fields we should prefill for managers?

rachel (DevEx): welcome omar! :wave: Templates were moved last quarter. canonical path now: Company Home > Onboarding Hub > Templates. the 'First Month Checklist' template is in Onboarding Hub/Templates/People.

omar (new hire): found the hub but the template shows "Request access" when i click duplicate. i submitted via the access form but wanted to confirm if there's a faster route.

hr-bot: Access requests for Notion templates are handled via https://redwood.internal/access-requests. include your Notion profile email and team name. People Ops triages during business hours.

noa (Docs Owner): @omar i checked — your account exists but you're not in the "onboard-editors" Notion group which is required to duplicate templates that include automation blocks. if you need it now i can grant you a one-off copy and set properties for you.

omar (new hire): thanks noa — could you also explain the "Template Variables" at the top of the template? it has fields like {{ManagerEmail}} and {{StartDate}}. are those auto-populated?

noa (Docs Owner): good callout. the template supports light substitution when duplicated from the Onboarding Hub if your account has the "onboard-editors" flag. that pulls data from HRIS (name, manager, start date). if you duplicate without that permission you9ll need to fill the variables manually. we recommend filling Owner, Manager, Team, StartDate, and HRIS-ID.

jules (manager): quick add from manager side: when you share the page with me, set my permission to "Can comment" while it's a draft, then switch to "Can edit" after we verify the checklist. if you want me to prefill anything i can do it on my end.

omar (new hire): perfect. one last thing  is it okay to keep the draft in my Private space until manager sign-off or should I create it directly under /Engineering/Onboarding?

rachel (DevEx): keep drafts in your Private space or under /Engineering/Onboarding/Drafts/<team>. when it's signed off, move it to /Engineering/Onboarding/Completed and add the page property "Onboarded" with the date. also tag @noa for a quick docs checklist review.

omar (new hire): awesome thanks everyone! pinging @noa with the link once it's ready.

noa (Docs Owner): happy to review. note: if you need automation enabled (HR sync / Slack reminders) we need a ticket to infra with the page URL — automation is gated for security.

hr-bot: Reminder: transfer of page ownership must go through access-requests and include target owner email and page URL.
